items.title: Binance says phase one of withdrawals opens after $6.3B hack
items.summary: The crypto exchange said it has begun phased withdrawals after the record hack the FBI has blamed on North Korea.

items.title: FBI blames North Korea for record $6.3B Binance hack
items.summary: US agency seeks private-sector help to block further money-laundering of stolen digital assets.

items.title: Binance Hack: Everything You Need to Know About the Biggest Crypto Heist in History
items.summary: Attackers tied to North Korea drained roughly $6.4 billion from the worlds largest crypto exchange.

items.title: Hackers hijack a dozen DeFi websites, all registered with Name.com, and steal about $138,000
items.summary: All 12 hijacked domains are registered through Name.com, suggesting a compromise.

items.title: Zero-token withdrawals let a hacker drain 97 million CORE from Bitcoin staking platform b14g
items.summary: Bitcoin staking platform b14g suffered a $1.47 million exploit on Oct. 31, losing approximately 97 million CORE tokens.

items.title: Binance opens crypto withdrawals in phases starting with bitcoin following $6.3 billion hack
items.summary: Binance reopens customer withdrawals following a record $6.3 billion exploit. Bitcoin leads the first phase.

items.title: FBI confirms North Korea's role in $6 billion Binance hack, asks DeFi community to block BTC, ETH, SOL addresses
items.summary: FBI lists addresses; Chainalysis notes attackers used thousands already.
